approved_scope: Build a bilingual website with an online booking flow for Willow Harbor Studio. The client will provide its existing logo, website copy, domain access, and booking rules before launch.
proposal_text: Approved website project for Willow Harbor Studio: bilingual pages and an online booking flow. Delivery starts after brand assets, website copy, domain access, booking rules, and kickoff availability are supplied. Changes to commerce or advertising require a separate approval.
